Title: Discovery Park
Note: 534 acres and a lighthouse. The loop trail is the default walk.

Title: Kubota Garden
Note: Free, in South Seattle, and almost nobody who lives here has been.

Title: Washington Park Arboretum
Note: Go in April for the azaleas, October for everything else.

Title: Golden Gardens Park
Note: Beach fires, Olympics across the water, sunset in summer.

Title: Alki Beach
Note: West Seattle. The skyline view everyone thinks is from downtown.

Title: Gas Works Park
Note: A decommissioned gasification plant you are allowed to climb on.
